facts.fact: Togo Réveil reports that the communication ministry's adviser said Togo's law on access to public information and documentation was adopted in 2016 and has been implemented since, and a press-body speaker referred to the law and its application decree as existing.
facts.system: Loi d'accès à l'information et à la documentation publiques

facts.fact: The Observatoire Togolais des Médias representative is quoted as saying the law has an application decree (decree undated in the article).
facts.system: Décret d'application de la loi d'accès à l'information
